module.title: Customer and Partner Relationship Management
module.business_purpose: The internal CRM the clients asked for: a first-class contact and company (account) database, lead capture and qualification, sales/partnership pipelines with stages and opportunities, a logged activity timeline (calls, emails, meetings, notes, tasks), and a dedicated partnerships/alliances registry that ties commercial relationships to formal contracts (module 38 ERP) and advertising partners (module 43 ads). This is the commercial system-of-record for the operator, kept separate from clinical patient data.
